Title: KeyError crashing the CLI when a note has no tags

Steps:
1. Put a note without tags in notes.json: [{"title": "hello", "body": "x"}]
2. Run `python -m tinydb_demo list --format tags`
3. The process exits with a traceback:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tinydb_demo/cli.py", line 13, in main
    print(format_tags(note))
  File "tinydb_demo/format.py", line 2, in format_tags
    return ', '.join(sorted(note['tags']))
KeyError: 'tags'

Expected: it should print an empty tag list instead of crashing.
